notes: Created BDD implementation plan for 7 pre-merge review issues. Plan covers 4 phases: (1) Wheel event preventDefault guard (P0, Issue #1), (2) Render order + pointer coordination (P1, Issues #2, #3), (3) Pointer capture hygiene (P2, Issues #5, #6), (4) Documentation + callback architecture (P2, Issues #4, #7). Includes 15 new unit test scenarios across 3 test files (MultiTouchHandlerTest, RenderingTest, UndoManagerTest), Given-When-Then scenarios at user/component/pure-function levels, module interface change documentation, risk assessment, and success criteria. Consulted @world-review for UX impact analysis and @planner for technical approach design. Read all 7 affected source files, 4 existing test files, and the change request specification.
